_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): daily high temperature at a named station (NWS observations)
claim: The maximum observed temperature at NWS station KNYC on 2026-12-25 (UTC day) is at least 5 degrees Celsius.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show NWS station KNYC observations on 2026-12-25 UTC whose maximum temperature value is at least 5 degrees Celsius with quality control V?

custom_definitions: The UTC calendar day is used, never local midnight. Only observations with qualityControl 'V' (verified) count; 'Z'/'S' preliminary values do not.
Station is pinned by id; the observation list must cover the whole UTC day (first and last observation within 2 hours of the day bounds) or the element is not proven.
Source revision: NWS corrects observations for days; the figure at the evidence cutoff controls (CORRECTED_V1).
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
